episodes.title: Dude, Where's My Groom?
episodes.description: A groom goes missing, and the CSIs recreate his debauched bachelor party to solve the case and a murder. In the meantime, former lab tech Walter Simmons joins the group as a new CSI.

episodes.title: It Happened to Me
episodes.description: When a software company executive bleeds to death on a Manhattan street, the CSIs must delve into the wet and messy world of food "sploshing" parties - where groups of people experience food in an sensual way - to find his killer.

episodes.title: Death and the Maiden
episodes.description: The CSIs discover that two apparently unrelated crimes are actually parts of the same twisted revenge plot.

episodes.title: Bone Voyage
episodes.description: Raymond Langston (Laurence Fishburne) from Las Vegas travels to Miami to aid a murder with possible ties to a human leg that was discovered in Vegas. This is the first part of the CSI: Trilogy.

episodes.title: Hammer Down
episodes.description: A big rig accident results in the discovery of an interstate trucking ring that specializes in human cargo and black market organ harvesting -- and sets off a race against time to save a hostage.

episodes.title: The Lost Girls
episodes.description: The CSI team helps Langston investigate a prostitution ring that may have harbored a hostage Langston had been looking for in Miami and New York.

episodes.title: Point of Impact
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate a horrible car crash to discover who or what caused it. The probe reveals the darkest secrets of the drivers involved.

episodes.title: Cuckoo's Nest
episodes.description: After a body falls from the 59th Street Bridge, the CSI team finds a compass near the body pointing east, and realizes it's the third victim of the Compass Killer. Meanwhile, detective Flack, still dealing with Angell's death, goes AWOL.

episodes.title: Lover's Lanes
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate a murder at a bowling alley after a critical piece of evidence is revealed during a bowling tournament.

episodes.title: Kill Clause
episodes.description: Horatio and his team investigate when deadly jellyfish are used as murder weapons. Meanwhile, a mysterious woman from Jesse's past unexpectedly shows up.

episodes.title: Manhattanhenge
episodes.description: Mac and the team lose the Compass Killer at the World's Fair site, and they soon discover through the use of astronomy and sunrises that it's only a matter of time before he targets the next victim.

episodes.title: Count Me Out
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate the death of a census worker, which leads to a high-speed car chase and an explosion that puts Ryan and Natalia in danger.

episodes.title: Death House
episodes.description: Mummified remains are found in a booby-trapped Manhattan penthouse that has been closed off for more than 80 years, and Mac and Stella race against time to find the people who discovered the body, who are still trapped in the building.

episodes.title: Appendicitement
episodes.description: When Nick, Greg and Hodges take Henry to celebrate his birthday at a biker bar, they uncover a double homicide and find several suspects still at the bar who may be the murderers.

episodes.title: Delko for the Defense
episodes.description: The team discovers that Delko is working for an attorney defending a homeless man accused of raping and killing a wealthy woman.

episodes.title: Second Chances
episodes.description: CSI uncovers a plot to collect millions of dollars in life insurance after a reformed homeless man is found dead in an alley.

episodes.title: Better Off Dead
episodes.description: The CSIs dig to find the truth about how a recent shootout at a gun store might connect to a young woman who may have committed suicide.

episodes.title: Show Stopper
episodes.description: When America's sweetheart (Phoenicks) bursts into flames during a concert, the CSIs expose the dark side of pop stardom.

episodes.title: Criminal Justice
episodes.description: A murder trial is delayed and the suspect is released on bail after Stella discovers that the district attorney in the case tampered with the crime scene for personal gain.

episodes.title: Sin City Blue
episodes.description: Two beautiful women are murdered in a Las Vegas hotel and the CSIs uncover an unusual killer during their investigation. Meanwhile, Langston continues to hunt "Dr. Jekyll".

episodes.title: Die By The Sword
episodes.description: A man is chopped in half, and the lab tries to tie the case to a Japanese mobster, who seeks custody of his biological son, who was adopted by the victim. Meanwhile, Natalia's hearing loss nearly makes her a victim during the investigation.

episodes.title: Flag on the Play
episodes.description: When a beautiful star quarterback of the Lingerie Football League is found murdered in the locker room hot tub with traces of lidocaine in her system, the CSIs are called in to find out who wanted her dead.

episodes.title: Long Ball
episodes.description: The CSI team delves into the world of professional golf when the body of a legendary player is discovered during a high-profile tournament.

episodes.title: In The Wind
episodes.description: Horatio and the CSIs have just 24 hours to find out if a man on death row is truly guilty of killing his wife and young daughter.

episodes.title: Sanguine Love
episodes.description: When a young woman's body is found in Central Park, drained of blood and missing part of her ear, the CSIs jump start an investigation that takes them into the dark and mysterious subculture of vampirism.

episodes.title: Internal Combustion
episodes.description: The case of two high school students, one dead and one missing, lead the CSIs into the underbelly of streetcar racing and a tangled web of deadly competition.

episodes.title: Miami, We Have A Problem
episodes.description: A dead body falls from the sky, and the team discovers that he had been a passenger on a private commercial space flight.

episodes.title: The Formula
episodes.description: The team tries to figure out who rigged a race car to go up in flames and leave its legendary driver in critical condition.

episodes.title: L.A.
episodes.description: Horatio and Delko travel to Los Angeles to clear Cardoza of an evidence tampering allegation that threatens the prosecution in a current Miami murder case.

episodes.title: Uncertainty Rules
episodes.description: The team must unravel the series of events from a wild night for a group of friends--a night which ended in four dead bodies, and a fifth person wandering the streets covered in blood and wielding an ax.

episodes.title: Unshockable
episodes.description: When a band member of Rascal Flatts is electrocuted by his own guitar during a concert, the CSI team investigates if it was a case of foul play.

episodes.title: Getting Axed
episodes.description: The team does not have any difficulty finding suspects when a hated receptionist is murdered with an axe and her body is pushed down a evelvator shaft. The real difficulty is finding out who did it.

episodes.title: Pot of Gold
episodes.description: The team discovers that a double homicide is related to an investigation by a pair of journalist bloggers into fraud by a company that makes gold bullion.

episodes.title: Neverland
episodes.description: When a young boy is found murdered, the CSI team uncovers evidence that may link his death to an old case that recently resurfaced.

episodes.title: Dishonor
episodes.description: Horatio's son, Kyle, seeks his father's help in solving a murder.

episodes.title: The Panty Sniffer
episodes.description: Catherine and Detective Vartann are thrown together in a hotel room for 24 hours as they stake out a duo making drugs in the room next door. Meanwhile, Nick and Langston work a case that involves a fetish which has become big business in Vegas.

episodes.title: Rest in Peace, Marina Garito
episodes.description: Sid rules the death of a woman whose twin brother disappeared 15 years ago a suicide, but Stella is convinced that he is wrong and sets out to prove it.

episodes.title: Irradiator
episodes.description: When the CSI team investigates the brutal murder of a family, they trace the killer to the house next door, which might belong to the "Dr. Jekyll" serial killer.

episodes.title: Spring Breakdown
episodes.description: The CSIs work on solving three separate homicides that occurred during Spring Break vacation.

episodes.title: Redemption
episodes.description: Dr. Hawkes is trapped in a cell block during a security breach orchestrated by a familiar face from CSI's past, and the only person who can help him get to safety is the death row inmate who murdered his sister.

episodes.title: Field Mice
episodes.description: When Hodges and Wendy take a group of high school CSI Explorer Scouts on a field trip, they embellish their role in solving cases and take their assignment a little bit too far.

episodes.title: Backfire
episodes.description: The spirit of a victim haunts Calleigh until she is able to solve his murder.

episodes.title: World's End
episodes.description: When a student is discovered murdered at Lindsey's school, the investigation takes a sharp turn when the CSIs uncover an unlikely connection between the boy's death and atrocities of the past.

episodes.title: Take My Life, Please!
episodes.description: Legendary comic from the good old days of Las Vegas is set to reunite with his partner on stage for one night only, until one half of the famous duo is found dead.

episodes.title: Meltdown
episodes.description: Evidence is stolen from the lab following a diamond heist and Eric Delko returns.

episodes.title: Tales from the Undercard
episodes.description: The team uncovers an underground fighting league after they discover the body of a retired boxer buried under concrete at a construction site.

episodes.title: Lost & Found
episodes.description: Mother thought to be grieving for the loss of her family three years ago becomes a suspect in a CSI investigation.

episodes.title: Mommie Deadest
episodes.description: When a suburban soccer mom is murdered, the CSIs uncover her family's dark past, while Delko continues his undercover mission. At the end of the episode, Caliegh confronts Delko of what's going on and an explosions happens soon after.

episodes.title: Unusual Suspects
episodes.description: A teen is critically injured after being shot in an alleyway. The victim's younger brother witnessed the crime, but he cannot give an accurate description of the incident and shooter to the police.

episodes.title: Doctor Who
episodes.description: The CSI team must investigate one of their own when Langston is accused by a former colleague of being part of the Dr. Jekyll murders.

episodes.title: Time Bomb
episodes.description: When Horatio's ex-girlfriend is killed in an explosion, the team looks within their own department to find the killer. The team is uneasy as Eric returns to do some undercover investigation and evidence leads to the discovery of stolen diamonds in Ryan's house. They must find the real culprit and exonerate Ryan before things get out of hand.

episodes.title: Point of View
episodes.description: A murder is connected to suspicious behavior that Mac spies from his apartment while recovering from an injury, and his ex-girlfriend Peyton Driscoll may be connected to the case.

episodes.title: Meat Jekyll
episodes.description: The CSI's lives are on the line as they close in on the elusive Dr. Jekyll, and more than one member of the team may not live to see his capture.

episodes.title: All Fall Down (1)
episodes.description: A serial killer taunts the CSIs by leaving them cryptic hints, and the longer it takes them to decode these puzzles, the higher the death toll rises. In the opening sequence the daughter of the first victim can be heard singing the "Ashes ashes all fall down" chorus from the Grateful Dead's "Throwing Stones".

episodes.title: Vacation Getaway
episodes.description: Shane Casey is captured by police but soon escapes. He then leaves clues for the crime lab encrypted in dollar bills that suggest that Danny is his next target.

episodes.title: Shock Waves
episodes.description: Langston fights for his life after being stabbed by psychopath Nate Haskell, while the other CSIs attend a funeral that turns deadly.

episodes.title: The 34th Floor
episodes.description: CSI's newest employee stumbles upon a dead body in the crime lab, while Lindsay struggles to cope with the circumstances behind her commendation.

episodes.title: Pool Shark
episodes.description: Hysteria ensues when a shark attacks a woman in the pool at a Las Vegas casino "day club," and the CSIs must determine if the killer is human or shark.

episodes.title: Unfriendly Chat
episodes.description: Adam witnesses a murder during a random video chat, and the team discovers that the victim just so happens to be a music student who lives in Manhattan.

episodes.title: Fallen (2)
episodes.description: The CSI team loses Jesse Cardoza when a psychotic genius runs wild in Miami. In the cliffhanger episode from last season, the killer has released a gas into the lab's ventilation system and incapacitated the team. The CSI must find out who the killer is and beat the clock before it's too late.

episodes.title: Blood Moon
episodes.description: Vampire and werewolf convention is at the heart of a murder investigation in Las Vegas.

episodes.title: Damned If You Do
episodes.description: A mother identifies her son as the attacker in a brutal assault that left her seriously injured and her husband dead. But later she recants her positive identification, and another unrelated person confesses to the crime.

episodes.title: Sudden Death
episodes.description: When a bottle girl is murdered at an exclusive club, Horatio must search through Miami's most elite guest list to find her killer.

episodes.title: Sqweegel
episodes.description: Sqweegel, a serial killer who is punishing local heroes that harbor hidden secrets, is on the hunt in Las Vegas.

episodes.title: Sangre Por Sangre
episodes.description: A Puerto Rican gang leader that Mac helped put in prison many years ago is released, and suddenly the new leaders of the gang begin turning up dead.

episodes.title: See No Evil
episodes.description: A blind man is the only witness to the abduction of a young girl and leads the team to a familiar foe, Joe LeBrock. A jailbreak occurs and LeBrock reveals that they are targeting Caine.

episodes.title: House of Hoarders
episodes.description: Woman who suffers from a condition called "hoarding" becomes a murder suspect when a dead body is found buried under piles of trash and debris inside her home.

episodes.title: Out of the Sky
episodes.description: The team tries to find out who is responsible for a jewel heist at the home of a powerful defense attorney. However, they soon discover that everybody who comes in contact with the jewels is turning up dead.

episodes.title: Manhunt
episodes.description: The team must find out why the murderer, Memmo Fierro, of Horatio's wife, Marisol Delko-Caine, got out of prison and stop him before someone else becomes the next victim. In a hostage situation, Horatio and Eric do not kill him since his daughter is there. Memmo escapes and is uncaught by the end of the episode.

episodes.title: Cold Blooded
episodes.description: When a college student ends up dead after a "Walking with Dinosaurs" show, the CSIs must determine if his death was murder or accidental.

episodes.title: Do Not Pass Go
episodes.description: A married couple is led to believe that they have found their badly decomposed dead son in a car on the roof of a Wall Street building. However, further investigation reveals that the victim is one of the boy's college classmates.

episodes.title: Sleepless in Miami
episodes.description: When a man states he saw a murder before it happened, Natalia is sent undercover to find out the truth.

episodes.title: Bump and Grind
episodes.description: When the CSI team discovers the shredded remains of a man, they find themselves with multiple suspects who may be responsible for his death.

episodes.title: Hide Sight
episodes.description: Mac is on the hunt for a sniper who is using nitroglycerin in his bullets to explode on impact, and the prime suspect was once a missing boy from one of Mac's old cases.

episodes.title: Fracked
episodes.description: Two men are murdered right before exposing a natural gas company for poisoning residents in a farming town, and the CSIs must discover who is responsible for their deaths.

episodes.title: Scared Stiff
episodes.description: As the CSIs investigate a case involving a woman who appears to have been scared to death in a supposedly haunted section of Central Park, Mac stumbles on another dead body buried nearby in the same part of the park.

episodes.title: Reality Kills
episodes.description: When a reality star is murdered, the CSIs investigate the cast, the obsessed fans, and the stars' hidden pasts to find the killer.

episodes.title: Wild Life
episodes.description: Man's fatal fall from a hotel balcony launches the CSIs into an investigation to determine if his death was suicide or the result of foul play.

episodes.title: Justified
episodes.description: After the woman who assumed Chief of Detectives Carver's deceased sister's identity turns up dead, and the evidence continues to mount, Mac begins to suspect that Carver may have been responsible for both murders.

episodes.title: On the Hook
episodes.description: When a fisherman narrowly escapes death, the CSIs have to dodge bullets to keep him alive and find out who's after him.

episodes.title: Shop Till You Drop
episodes.description: A department store manager is found dead inside his store's holiday window display, and the prime suspect in the case, one of his assistant managers, refuses to say a word during her interrogation.

episodes.title: Happy Birthday
episodes.description: When a woman who is eight months pregnant is found beaten, Horatio and the team hunt down the attacker. [8]
The CSIs set out to track down a pedophile suspected of murdering an FBI agent's wife and kidnapping his children.

episodes.title: Blood Sugar
episodes.description: The investigation into an explosion at a sugar refinery exposes a shocking secret among the refinery's employees.

episodes.title: Match Made in Hell
episodes.description: When the investigation of a dead millionaire leads the CSIs to an elite dating service, Ryan poses as a wealthy businessman to expose the matchmaker's lies.

episodes.title: Man Up
episodes.description: The CSIs question the validity of an online picture depicting a murdered call girl until they find the same woman strangled to death in the dumpster that appears in the photo.

episodes.title: To What End?
episodes.description: After a man dressed in a clown costume kills a bakery owner, the evidence is soon connected to a man from Flack's past who reluctantly agreed to join witness protection to testify against drug dealers.

episodes.title: F-T-F
episodes.description: When a fire hydrant washes away all of the evidence at a crime scene, the CSIs must recreate a very bizarre double murder.

episodes.title: Holding Cell
episodes.description: Mac is forced to work with a Barcelona detective to find out if the death of a Spanish man in New York city was a homicide or suicide.

episodes.title: Wheels Up
episodes.description: When the CSIs investigate a murder at a roller derby match, the only thing shorter than the girls' skirts are their tempers.

episodes.title: A Kiss Before Frying
episodes.description: The CSIs link a body with severe burn marks to possible execution by electric chair - and to a legendary Vegas murder. Meanwhile, Greg asks out Ellen, a pretty schoolteacher and forensics enthusiast who has been touring the crime lab.

episodes.title: The Two Mrs. Grissoms
episodes.description: Night full of celebration ends with a bang when the director of a scholarship foundation for the deaf is killed by a deadly car bomb, prompting Sara to interrogate the students and faculty of the college where her mother-in-law works.

episodes.title: Party Down
episodes.description: An exclusive party in the back of an 18-wheeler ends in death when the driver sends the vehicle into the Hudson River, and the team tries to figure out what happened. However, a mobster whose daughter was killed may beat CSI to the killer.

episodes.title: All That Cremains
episodes.description: Thrift store donation turns gruesome when a dead body is found in a box; meanwhile, Langston's wife pays a surprise visit to the crime lab.

episodes.title: Smooth Criminal
episodes.description: When the CSIs track down a suave and charming hitman, their investigation uncovers a conspiracy with far-reaching implications.

episodes.title: Targets of Obsession
episodes.description: Langston testifies against the notorious "Dick & Jane" killer, Nate Haskell. Meanwhile, Nick receives a call from troubled teen Jason McCann to warn him of impending danger.

episodes.title: Vigilante
episodes.description: When a serial rapist is found murdered, restrained in the same manner as his victims, the CSIs weigh a feeling of justice against their sense of duty to pursue the killer.

episodes.title: Last Stand
episodes.description: The killer of Horatio's wife returns and takes control of the city, and Horatio must stop him before more crimes and chaos happen.

episodes.title: Turn On, Tune In, Drop Dead
episodes.description: The CSIs are on zombie alert when two men initially pronounced dead mysteriously come back to life.

episodes.title: The Untouchable
episodes.description: A troubled woman who once turned to Mac after witnessing a group of men trying to cover up a murder, turns up dead herself under very suspicious circumstances.

episodes.title: Stoned Cold
episodes.description: When a popular high school girl is stoned to death, Horatio and his team must find out who took revenge on her. The investigations hit a snag when they discover that the girl was perhaps not so popular after all.

episodes.title: Blood Lust
episodes.description: Horatio and his team must track down a serial killer who attempts to kill a woman who narrowly escapes death.

episodes.title: The List
episodes.description: While investigating the murder of a convicted ex-cop, the CSIs stumble upon a list in his prison cell with names of several individuals he believed might have been his wife's true killer.

episodes.title: Do or Die
episodes.description: CSI uncovers plenty of inappropriate behavior at one of New York's most prestigious prep schools after one of the school's brightest students is murdered.

episodes.title: Hunting Ground
episodes.description: When a man is shot and killed by a bow and arrow, Horatio goes against the clock to solve the case involving an exclusive hunting club that hunts humans for sport.

episodes.title: Special Delivery
episodes.description: A connection involving the murder of a delivery truck driver and a housewife must be solved, on why both of them were murdered on a particular route.

episodes.title: About Face
episodes.description: After Natalia is kidnapped and held captive by an escaped prisoner, she hears a shocking secret.

episodes.title: Hitting for the Cycle
episodes.description: String of deaths, including a gamer found dead on his couch and a newly divorced man at the bottom of a pool, instigate a bet among the CSIs as to whether they've "hit for the cycle" - a homicide, a suicide, an accidental and a natural death all in one night.

episodes.title: Identity Crisis
episodes.description: Det. Josephine "Jo" Danville's adopted daughter, Ellie becomes a key witness in a murder investigation.

episodes.title: Unleashed
episodes.description: Langston and Sara turn to Lady Heather for help in tracking down the culprit responsible for injuring a woman before she was seemingly mauled to death by a mountain lion. Meanwhile, Nick and Dr. Robbins manage to rescue the unborn baby of a teenage girl who appears to have committed suicide.

episodes.title: Food for Thought
episodes.description: While the team investigates the explosion of a gourmet food truck, Sheldon's new relationship could get him in big trouble at the lab.

episodes.title: Caged
episodes.description: Horatio and his team try to protect - but must uncover the secrets of - a mixed martial arts fighter whose former friend (that he testified against) has escaped prison.

episodes.title: Paint It Black
episodes.description: A college student is found dead at the campus pool and the CSIs are forced to be innovative as their only witness is an art student with cognitive memory problems.

episodes.title: Father of the Bride
episodes.description: Following his escape, Nate Haskell, the notorious "Dick & Jane" killer, resurfaces when he e-mails a disturbing video to the father of one of his brides, threatening to take her life.

episodes.title: Nothing for Something
episodes.description: While the team stumbles upon a missing person case while investigating a murder, Mac has a brush with an ex-con whom he and his first partner put away many years earlier.

episodes.title: G.O.
episodes.description: Horatio chases down a murder suspect whose entire life is an elaborate charade.

episodes.title: Cello and Goodbye
episodes.description: Langston becomes more determined than ever to track down Nake Haskell, the notorious "Dick & Jane" killer, after discovering that he's kidnapped his ex-wife, Gloria.

episodes.title: Life Sentence
episodes.description: After Raymond Harris retaliates against Mac and his retired first partner, Mac begins to discover more about Harris's motives and his ex-partner's dirty laundry.

episodes.title: Mayday (1)
episodes.description: Horatio must capture an escapee again when their transport plane crashes and the team is shocked to discover that the fugitive has planned more than that. The episode ends with Randy North shooting Horatio, leaving the Lt. injured while Natalia is placed in the trunk of a car which is then thrown into the ocean, leaving both of their fates unknown.

episodes.title: In a Dark, Dark House
episodes.description: After years of pursuit and a countless number of murders, Langston comes face-to-face with serial killer Nate Haskell inside the house where his killing spree began.

episodes.title: Exit Strategy
episodes.description: After Mac is nearly killed trying to apprehend a criminal, he decides to tackle a cold case involving a double homicide and child abduction during a bodega robbery.

episodes.title: 73 Seconds
episodes.description: Multiple shootings and stabbings on a public tram leave the CSI team with one witness and a lot of questions.

episodes.title: Indelible
episodes.description: On the 10th anniversary of 9/11, Mac and the team remember specific moments from that day that were indelibly burned in their mind.

episodes.title: Countermeasures (2)
episodes.description: After Horatio heroically saves Natalia, our CSIs must race against time to find wanted fugitives Jack Toller and Randy North. As the team stages an elaborate trap to lure North from hiding, Toller sells his two remaining engraving plates in exchange for some cash and a young woman he plans on making his next victim. CSIs then capture North and use him to lure out Toller so they can save the girl he plans to kill. But when the setup goes south, and Toller vanishes, the team is forced to reexamine Toller's original case files for any last minute clues to his whereabouts.

episodes.title: Tell Tale Hearts
episodes.description: Three suspects come forward with three different reasons why they killed an entire family and the CSI team has to determine who is telling the truth.

episodes.title: Keep It Real
episodes.description: The boyfriend of a punk rock singer is shot to death in his apartment, and the key to solving the crime may be his missing roommate.

episodes.title: Stiff
episodes.description: The CSI investigates a murder that will lead the team into the world of gigolos.

episodes.title: Bittersweet
episodes.description: While on a date, Stokes realizes a piece of art at an exhibit has decomposing body parts in it, which leads to a full-blown investigation. Also, D.B. Russell makes a decision to ground one of the staff from the case.

episodes.title: Cavallino Rampante
episodes.description: The dead body of a high end car thief is found in the trunk of a car she stole, and her family may be in danger.

episodes.title: Blown Away
episodes.description: A tornado touches down on a murder scene, damaging the evidence and putting Ryan and Walter in grave danger.

episodes.title: Maid Man
episodes.description: The former Mayor of Las Vegas is shot at the Mob Museum and the CSIs embark on a history lesson in search of clues.

episodes.title: Officer Involved
episodes.description: One of Danny's rookie officers claims that she shot an armed man who attacked Danny outside of a barroom. However, the gun is not at the scene, and is used in a later shooting.

episodes.title: Look Who's Taunting
episodes.description: The team chases a sadistic killer who takes women's eyes, and a new nemesis (Carlos Bernard) challenges Horatio.

episodes.title: CSI Down
episodes.description: When a hijacked medevac helicopter with CSI Brody aboard goes missing, the entire team is on hunt.

episodes.title: Air Apparent
episodes.description: When a young woman is stabbed to death, the junkie brother of a high school basketball phenom is accused.

episodes.title: Killer Regrets
episodes.description: A Mexican sheriff (Kate Del Castillo) whose life is threatened by drug cartels seek Horatio's help. Some Mala Noche are linked with the case and Horatio is forced to seek an old nemesis for inside information.

episodes.title: By The Book
episodes.description: In a deserted mansion, the CSIs find a body hanging that appears to have been killed by a vampire.In a deserted mansion, the CSIs find a body hanging that appears to have been killed by a vampire.

episodes.title: Freaks & Geeks
episodes.description: When a Jane Doe is found near the freakish attractions of a 19th-century-inspired traveling sideshow, the team investigates a cast of unusual characters.

episodes.title: Get Me Out of Here!
episodes.description: A fraternity pledge master is found dead in an open grave, and the team soon suspects that one of his pledges may be buried alive in another cemetery in New York City.

episodes.title: Sinner Takes All
episodes.description: A high-stakes poker game ends quickly when a masked assassin kills one of the players.

episodes.title: Brain Doe
episodes.description: When the CSI team arrives at a car crash, they find three casualties and a human brain that doesn't belong to any of the victims. Also, D.B. Russell is concerned his son is not focused on college following his suspension from school.

episodes.title: Crushed
episodes.description: A dead body is found in the remains of a collapsed porch from a high school party, and the team discovers that she was strangled before the accident. Meanwhile, a serial rapist from one of Jo's past cases strikes in New York City.

episodes.title: Dead Ringer
episodes.description: When another corpse is found with missing eyes, Horatio suspects "The Taunter" is back.

episodes.title: Crime After Crime
episodes.description: When the CSI team investigates three seemingly unrelated murders, they discover someone is getting revenge for cold case murders that were never solved.

episodes.title: Crossroads
episodes.description: The team tries to identify the shooter and motive in the assassination of a criminal court judge presiding over the trial of a Russian mobster, while Mac and Lindsay prepare for the hearing against serial rapist John Curtis.

episodes.title: A Few Dead Men
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate when three convicted murderers are released from prison and someone starts killing them one by one.

episodes.title: Means to an End
episodes.description: The ability to find justice for John Curtis is put in jeopardy when he is freed on bail, the accuser is killed, and the team uncovers a possible conspiracy to frame him.

episodes.title: Long Gone
episodes.description: Horatio is determined to find a family that completely disappeared.

episodes.title: Zippered
episodes.description: When the CSI team discovers a deceased rancher was also a ballistics expert, they have to work with the FBI to solve the case.

episodes.title: Crowned
episodes.description: The CSIs expose the seedy underbelly of children's beauty pageants when a contestant's mother is murdered. But as one of the girls goes missing, the team makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Genetic Disorder
episodes.description: When the body of a naked dead man is discovered by Dr. Robbins' wife in their master bedroom, it leads to a lot of questions for the CSI team.

episodes.title: Clean Sweep
episodes.description: The team suspects that a badly burned corpse may be of a cage fighter, but later discovers that he may have faked his own death.

episodes.title: Friendly Fire
episodes.description: An eccentric genius is assassinated with the most unique weapon the CSIs have ever seen.

episodes.title: Who's There?
episodes.description: A real estate mogul is killed in a home invasion, but was somebody close to him ultimately responsible for his death?

episodes.title: Ms. Willows Regrets…
episodes.description: When Willows works with the FBI again after a professional hit occurs at a law firm she recommended to her friend, the CSI team identifies shocking similarities at the crime scene.

episodes.title: Willows in the Wind
episodes.description: The CSI team says goodbye to Catherine Willows as she makes a life-changing decision.

episodes.title: Terminal Velocity
episodes.description: When a skydiver is murdered, the CSIs discover that he has 103 children and all of them are suspects.

episodes.title: Brooklyn ‘Til I Die
episodes.description: While investigating a murder, the team discovers that the son of a hedge fund billionaire has been kidnapped.

episodes.title: Tressed to Kill
episodes.description: When a woman is found dead and her hair is done up '70s style complete with vintage clothes, the CSI team discovers clues that point to a killer with a hair fetish.

episodes.title: The Ripple Effect
episodes.description: When the same type of chewing gum is found at two separate crime scenes involving two dead bodies, Jo operates on a hunch that the two cases may be related.

episodes.title: Seeing Red
episodes.description: Russell asks for advice from a former colleague on a case involving the death of a man's ex-girlfriend.

episodes.title: Last Straw
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate the murder of a woman who rode her horse at a local stable and was a former sorority queen in college. At first they suspect a sorority sister, but when she too is murdered, the team realizes the killer is sending a message. After the CSIs discover that the two murdered women kicked the stable owner's daughter out of the same sorority years ago, they suspect the woman finally got her revenge on her harassers. However, when the killer's DNA is found on the first victim's horse, it's revealed to be the woman's father, who couldn't stand the way the sorority girls broke his daughter's confidence years ago and then resumed their torment at the stable. After he is arrested, the daughter tries to hang herself, but Horatio gets there in time to save her. In the end, Horatio gives her the hope and confidence to start a new life.

episodes.title: Stealing Home
episodes.description: When a house is stolen completely off its foundation, the CSIs are on the case in search of answers. Meanwhile, new CSI Julie Finlay showcases her skill in blood analysis.

episodes.title: CSI Unplugged
episodes.description: When a blackout cripples the city, the CSIs must revert to old-school methods to solve the case of a missing child.

episodes.title: No Good Deed
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate the death of Henry Duncan when his body washes ashore after being gored by a speeding boat. The boat, stolen from its owner, is found with traces of car oil. Duncan, an accountant, was a do-gooder and was about to expose improper business practices going on within his company and a home builder. On his way to work Duncan noticed a young boy in distress, follows him, and sees him get into a car with a tatted guy. However, Duncan gets cut off by a truck driver going the opposite direction. It turns out the kid was being used as a drug mule. Henry calls 9-1-1 to report what looks like the abduction of the kid and then calls the call center listed on the back of the truck to report the bad driving. It turns out the truck driver was fired as a result of Henry's call. In revenge, the driver stole the boat and killed Henry.

episodes.title: Rest In Pieces
episodes.description: The CSIs uncover a female victim on the Navarro estate that matches Esteban's MO. Vina Navarro, Esteban's grandmother, comes forward to help solve the case. However, things take a twist when the team also discovers the three-decade-old remains of a male victim, with evidence linking Diego to the murder. Before he can be arrested, Vina shoots Diego in what appears to be self-defense. Later, the team decodes a microchip disguised as a lollipop in Diego's pocket, which leads them to Esteban's murder lair and the evidence needed to put him away for good.

episodes.title: Trends with Benefits
episodes.description: The CSIs are brought in to solve the case of a recently murdered student whose death photo ends up trending on the Internet.

episodes.title: At Risk
episodes.description: When a rabid dog kills a janitor at a renowned tennis academy, it's clear someone engineered the attack to target Coach Larry Hopper, Miami's most popular tennis coach. The team discovers Hopper was involved in a child sexual abuse case ten years prior, but settled out of court. Could the victim now be back for revenge? Calleigh learns that Austin North is a student at the academy and grows suspicious when pro player and academy alumnus, Jack Brody, takes a special interest in him. Forensics prove that Brody orchestrated the attack, and he eventually confesses to sending in the wild dog in an attempt to prevent Hopper from molesting Austin next. It's also discovered that the janitor knew that Hopper was assaulting young boys but chose to look the other way.

episodes.title: Malice in Wonderland
episodes.description: When the CSI team is called in to investigate a robbery-homicide at an "Alice In Wonderland"-themed wedding, they have little to work with to find a killer. Meanwhile, Hodges' mother comes to town, and he wants her to believe Morgan is his girlfriend.

episodes.title: Law and Disorder (1)
episodes.description: When a freelance journalist is poisoned, the CSIs must figure out if her murder was provoked by a story she was doing on Miami Councilman Randall Stafford. After Stafford's DNA is found at her apartment, his attorneys, Darren Vogel and Gabrielle Wade, are able to dismiss the evidence on grounds of tampering. The team begins suspecting the journalist was actually doing a story on Vogel, not Stafford, after discovering that Stafford helped cover up a murder committed by another of Vogel's clients. It turns out that Vogel is blackmailing his clients to facilitate his firm, and he likely had Denise killed after discovering she was on to him through Stafford. Before they can arrest Vogel, Gabrielle admits to being the sole instigator of the firm's criminality, even though Horatio suspects Vogel is blackmailing her into being his scapegoat. And Calleigh reveals to Eric that she is thinking of adopting Austin and Patty North.

episodes.title: Flash Pop
episodes.description: When one of their own is killed, the CSIs must figure out why the murder scene is a detailed recreation of an unsolved case from 1957. Also, Mac and Christine continue to grow closer.

episodes.title: Split Decisions
episodes.description: When the CSI team is called in to investigate a man who is shot at point-blank range in a local casino, they shut down the entire building to find their killer.

episodes.title: Kill Screen
episodes.description: A process server is killed, and the team finds out he treats his job just like a video game of track and complete missions. The murderer is linked to competitive video games in a tournament.

episodes.title: Habeas Corpse (2)
episodes.description: CSI Wolfe is a suspect when one of the team's enemies, ASA Josh Avery, is murdered. When the investigation becomes deadly, Samantha Owens ends up having to be rescued. The episode ends with Ryan's discovering that Sam is the one responsible for killing Josh. Also, Calleigh ends up adopting Austin and Patty North.

episodes.title: Altered Stakes
episodes.description: When Stokes learns that a man he helped put in prison is going to have his conviction overturned, the CSI team needs to prove the killer is guilty again or he will be released.

episodes.title: Sláinte
episodes.description: The team tries to figure out who killed a Hell's Kitchen businessman and placed his body parts at the four corners that mark the neighborhood's original boundaries.

episodes.title: Dune and Gloom
episodes.description: When a bomb kills an off-road race truck driver mid-race, the CSI team is called on the scene to investigate why.

episodes.title: Unwrapped
episodes.description: A woman claims that her husband was accidentally shot and killed in the lobby of a building, but the team soon discovers that she is hiding a lot of secrets about the crime.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates three dead bodies just blocks away from a campaign dinner, they think they know who the killer is before making a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Near Death
episodes.description: A robbery takes place while Mac is in a convenience store. He is shot and in critical condition. The team rushes to find the shooter.

episodes.title: Karma to Burn
episodes.description: Russell's granddaughter was kidnapped in last season's finale cliffhanger and now he leads the CSI team on a hunt to find her.

episodes.title: Reignited
episodes.description: Mac needs the help of a convicted arsonist recently released from prison to investigate the death of one of his FDNY firefighter friends.

episodes.title: Where There's Smoke...
episodes.description: Arsonist Leonard Brooks strikes again, but CSI discovers that his mission this time is very personal.

episodes.title: Code Blue Plate Special
episodes.description: The CSIs arrive at their favorite diner only to discover a gruesome crime scene with eight dead victims and a lot of questions.

episodes.title: 2,918 Miles
episodes.description: A homicide on the Brooklyn Bridge leads Mac and Jo all the way to San Francisco to find a missing teenage girl, but they are not sure if she is dead or alive.

episodes.title: Wild Flowers
episodes.description: When a girl is shot and killed at a large rave in the desert, the CSI team has to search for clues, find her missing friend and bring the killer to justice.

episodes.title: Unspoken
episodes.description: CSI searches for the shooter at a political rally, and the gun that he discarded in an alley afterwards is used in the accidental shooting death of a young girl.

episodes.title: It Was a Very Good Year
episodes.description: When a famed music historian is murdered and left in a piano, it has an emotional effect on Sanders, who had a past with her.

episodes.title: Misconceptions
episodes.description: A 20 year old cold case involving a missing boy is reignited when the suspected killer is murdered after returning to the old neighborhood.

episodes.title: Play Dead
episodes.description: When a K-9 is blamed for the death of his partner, the CSI team discovers there's more to the case. Meanwhile, Finlay and Morgan investigate the death of a high-profile divorce lawyer with a lot of enemies.

episodes.title: The Lady in the Lake
episodes.description: While searching for a gun, the team stumbles on a dead body at the bottom of a Central Park pond.

episodes.title: Pick and Roll
episodes.description: Things get personal when D.B. Russell is drawn into the investigation of the death of his son's basketball coach.

episodes.title: Clue: SI
episodes.description: The team must solve a series of murders whose victims, locations, and murder weapons all resemble elements of the board game "Clue."

episodes.title: Fallen Angels
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates the death of a reverend who was killed at the grave site of former CSI Warrick Brown.

episodes.title: Late Admissions
episodes.description: The team connects the murder of a high schooler to a classmate who was dealing his prescription meds, and Lindsey returns home to take care of some unfinished business.

episodes.title: CSI on Fire
episodes.description: When five bodies are found in what appears to be a meteor site in the middle of the desert, CSI Finlay recognizes one of the casualties, prompting her to revisit her past.

episodes.title: Strip Maul
episodes.description: The CSI team lends a hand to local law enforcement on the strip with several arrests until a John Doe is found in car. Also, things become personal for Captain Brass when he discovers some facts about his daughter.

episodes.title: Blood Out
episodes.description: The team discovers that a Dominican gang member found cut in half by a chainsaw has a connection to Flack's new partner.

episodes.title: The Real McCoy
episodes.description: CSI tries to figure out who killed one of the owners of a modern-day speakeasy, and Adam tries to get through unresolved issues while taking care of his sick father.

episodes.title: Risky Business Class
episodes.description: When five people are killed in a small plane crash a mile off the Vegas strip, the CSI team is called to investigate. Also, Sara feels the strain of having a long-distance relationship with Grissom when a former lover of hers is involved with the crash investigation.

episodes.title: Command+P
episodes.description: Two people are shot and killed with a gun that was printed from a computer, and Jo tries to uncover the identity of an anonymous philanthropist who is giving away millions of dollars to random New Yorkers.

episodes.title: Civilized Lies
episodes.description: A police officer is killed during a robbery, but is a gunshot victim in police custody a reluctant eyewitness or one of the robbers?

episodes.title: Dead Air
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate the demise of a prominent news anchor during a live broadcast.

episodes.title: Nine Thirteen
episodes.description: The team tries to figure out who killed a pick-pocket who fell from a building balcony onto a car, and Jo gets a visit from a man who has shocking news related to her dead sister.

episodes.title: Double Fault
episodes.description: The CSIs need to ace the case involving a rising tennis star. Meanwhile, the CSIs are surprised to hear Hodges is engaged to an Italian bombshell.

episodes.title: White Gold
episodes.description: A pizza shop employee is killed over a package he was smuggling that was mistaken for drugs.

episodes.title: In Vino Veritas
episodes.description: When CSI Mac Taylor decides to surprise his girlfriend in Vegas, he discovers she's missing and asks his friend D.B. Russell for help. Meanwhile, the CSIs investigate the loss of a local wine collector on part one of a two-part crossover with CSI:NY.

episodes.title: Seth and Apep
episodes.description: With the help of D.B. Russell from the Las Vegas crime lab, Mac is able to identify the people who kidnapped Christine. But will he get to her before it's too late?

episodes.title: Exile
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate the demise of a famous Cuban singer's sister who's in town as part of a U.S. tour. Meanwhile, Hodges begins to get cold feet at the prospect of marrying his Italian bombshell girlfriend.

episodes.title: Blood Actually
episodes.description: The team solves three separate murders which occur on Valentine's Day. The CSI team and detectives all have their own valentine's celebrations.

episodes.title: Forget Me Not
episodes.description: Sara is a lead suspect in an investigation after a brief encounter with another man in which she was the last person to see him alive. Also, her separation from Grissom begins to take a toll.

episodes.title: Today is Life
episodes.description: A riot threatens to break out at a Manhattan precinct after an officer shoots and kills an allegedly unarmed black man during a chase.

episodes.title: Last Woman Standing
episodes.description: When several prominent poker players lose their lives, the CSI team is called to investigate before more victims surface.

episodes.title: Dead of the Class
episodes.description: The CSIs join David Phillips at his high school reunion when he discovers the prom queen's been murdered.

episodes.title: Sheltered
episodes.description: When the CSIs find a body near a forest reserve, they discover what might be a serial killer and his bizarre lair.

episodes.title: Backfire
episodes.description: When the CSIs investigate a triple homicide, Russell has to find a way to connect with a 6-year-old girl who was the sole survivor and witness.

episodes.title: Fearless
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates a popular spiritual retreat when a body is found floating in a mud bath. Meanwhile, Hodges questions his marriage plans to Elisabetta.

episodes.title: Ghosts of the Past
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates the death of a ghost hunter.

episodes.title: Skin in the Game
episodes.description: As Russell and his team investigate a series of murders, one of their own confronts peril on a dangerous undercover mission to get close to the killer.

episodes.title: The Devil and D.B. Russell
episodes.description: Russell leads the CSI team on a hunt to find Morgan and Ellie Brass following their kidnapping by a ritualistic killer.

episodes.title: Take the Money and Run
episodes.description: The CSI team is called in to investigate a murder and robbery at a poker game that had more than a million dollars in chips on the table.

episodes.title: Torch Song
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates a fire at a music venue that leaves four people dead, including two band members.

episodes.title: Last Supper
episodes.description: When contestants on a reality cooking show accidentally eat human flesh during a competition, the CSI team is brought in to investigate.

episodes.title: Frame by Frame
episodes.description: Catherine Willows returns to help the CSIs solve a cold case that has haunted the team for 14 years.

episodes.title: Passed Pawns
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates the death of a homeless man who had a huge winning streak at a small casino.

episodes.title: Under a Cloud
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates a John Doe found during torrential rains in Vegas. Meanwhile, Greg Sanders is investigated and accused of framing a man for murder seven years ago.

episodes.title: Helpless
episodes.description: When a man is found dead inside a human-sized hamster ball, the CSI team is brought in to investigate. Also, the team collaborates with a swing shift CSI on a case involving a serial rapist.

episodes.title: Check In and Check Out
episodes.description: The CSI team is called in to investigate the stabbing of a couple found at a local motel that is reminiscent of two incidents that occurred in the same room.

episodes.title: Girls Gone Wild
episodes.description: Spa weekend for Sara, Finlay and Morgan turns into a murder investigation and missing persons case when Finlay disappears, as the CSI team must piece together what happened in detail to find her.

episodes.title: The Lost Reindeer
episodes.description: When a man is found murdered at an elaborate holiday party complete with real snow and live reindeer, the CSI team is brought in to investigate.

episodes.title: Keep Calm and Carry On
episodes.description: Petty crime aboard an inbound plane to Vegas becomes a murder investigation when one of the passengers is found dead.

episodes.title: Boston Brakes
episodes.description: The CSIs are called to investigate a car crash and are shocked to discover the victim is someone they know.

episodes.title: De Los Muertos
episodes.description: When the CSI team works two separate investigations, one involving a woman found murdered in Mexico and another of a local couple found dead in their driveway, they find the evidence in one case may help the other.

episodes.title: Love for Sale
episodes.description: Nick and Greg investigate the death of a 16-year-old girl with ties to a brothel.

episodes.title: Killer Moves
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate the murders of an Elvis impersonator and a bird that are strangely connected.

episodes.title: Long Road Home
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate the murder of a rock and roll groupie and the disappearance of a prostitute that both have ties to a mysterious band.

episodes.title: Uninvited
episodes.description: The CSIs are called to investigate when an entire family is reported to have been missing for a month.

episodes.title: The Fallen
episodes.description: Russell is taken hostage after a teenager opens fire in a police station.

episodes.title: Consumed
episodes.description: The CSIs track a cannibalistic killer and discover he's not alone.

episodes.title: Kitty
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate the cyber-related murder of a prominent casino owner's wife and receive help from the FBI's Cyber Crime Division.

episodes.title: Dead in His Tracks
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate a present-day crime with ties to a mob heist that occurred 25 years ago. Meanwhile, Brass has a decision to make when his daughter attempts suicide.

episodes.title: The CSI Effect
episodes.description: Finlay must deal with a bomb planted in her car, while Russell gets a call from someone claiming to be the Gig Harbor killer.

episodes.title: Buzz Kill
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates a robbery and fatal shooting at a medical marijuana shop.

episodes.title: Bad Blood
episodes.description: Sara and Greg are quarantined after responding to a crime scene that's contaminated with a deadly pathogen.

episodes.title: The Book of Shadows
episodes.description: The CSI team suspects foul play when a chemistry teacher's science experiment goes horribly wron.

episodes.title: Girls Gone Wilder
episodes.description: Morgan, Sidle and Finlay try to relax at a forensics conference when a mass shooting occurs on site.

episodes.title: The Twin Paradox
episodes.description: Frustration mounts for the CSI team as another victim surfaces and all evidence points to the Gig Harbor Killer.

episodes.title: Road to Recovery
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates the death of a woman full of alcohol and drugs in a pool at a rehab facility.

episodes.title: Rubbery Homicide
episodes.description: The CSIs delve into the kinky world of "rubber dolls" when they investigate the murder of a man who was stabbed in an alley.

episodes.title: Let's Make a Deal
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate a murder at the Clark County jail after an inmate stumbles upon a body while running away from officers.

episodes.title: Dead Rails
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates the bizarre death of a man who was killed not once, but twice.

episodes.title: Angle of Attack
episodes.description: The CSI's investigation of the victim of an apparent hit and run leads them into the world of aeronautics.

episodes.title: Dead Woods
episodes.description: The CSI team reopens a 10-year-old murder/suicide case when the sole survivor claims her accused father was innocent.

episodes.title: The Greater Good
episodes.description: The CSI team learns the main suspect in the gig harbor killings is being released from jail due to lack of evidence.

episodes.title: Merchants of Menace
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates a homicide at a convention for people who collect macabre murder memorabilia.

episodes.title: Hero to Zero
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates the murder of a young victim dressed as a superhero.

episodes.title: The Last Ride
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates a death involving a vintage Rolls Royce and a chrome-covered victim.

episodes.title: Under My Skin
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates a murder with ties to two teenaged kidnapped girls.

episodes.title: The End Game
episodes.description: Season 15 ends with a final showdown between the CSIs and the Gig Harbor killer, whose motives are revealed. Meanwhile, Nick Stokes makes a decision that affects the team moving forward.

episodes.title: Kidnapping 2.0
episodes.description: Special agent Avery Ryan and her team of FBI cyber analysts investigate a case of hacked baby monitors.

episodes.title: CMND:\Crash
episodes.description: Agent Avery Ryan and her cyber team investigate a roller coaster crash caused by someone who found a way to hack into the ride's internal computer.

episodes.title: Killer En Route
episodes.description: The cyber team investigates when a car service company's dispatch software is hacked in order to target certain passengers.

episodes.title: Fire Code
episodes.description: Avery and her team investigate a new cyber threat that allows arsonists a less traceable method of starting fires in homes. Meanwhile, Elijah's ex-wife informs him she's starting a new job out of town and wants to take their daughter with her.

episodes.title: Crowd Sourced
episodes.description: The Cyber team must track down a bomber fixated on revealing the "truth" about society's overreliance on technology.

episodes.title: The Evil Twin
episodes.description: Avery and her team investigate the murder of a woman whose electronic devices indicate that she was alive for three days after her official time of death.

episodes.title: URL, Interrupted
episodes.description: The Cyber team investigates when a high school victim of intense cyberbullying by her classmates pledges to retaliate.

episodes.title: Selfie 2.0
episodes.description: The cyber team investigates the abductions of young women whose social network pages are being kept up to date. Also, Ryan helps Trish McCarthy cope with the death of Trish's sister, Ryan's former psych patient.

episodes.title: L0m1S
episodes.description: The cyber crime team investigates when nine planes that departed from the same airport face a coordinated Wi-Fi attack while in flight.

episodes.title: Click Your Poison
episodes.description: Special Agent Avery Ryan and her team investigate when a man dies after taking medication he purchased from a hacked ad on a medical website.

episodes.title: Ghost in the Machine
episodes.description: The cyber team tracks a killer who hacks into a popular online game and tricks gamers into delivering illegal weapons.

episodes.title: Bit by Bit
episodes.description: The cyber team investigates when a hacker uses a power outage in Detroit to mask a jewelry store robbery-homicide in which gems weren't the target.

episodes.title: Family Secrets
episodes.description: Avery confronts the hacker who released her patient's information online when she was a psychologist. Meanwhile, Krumitz confronts the man who murdered his parents.

episodes.title: Immortality (1)
episodes.description: In the series finale, Grissom and Willows return to help the CSIs solve a catastrophic case that paralyzes all of Las Vegas

episodes.title: Immortality (2)
episodes.description: Part 2 of 2. The series concludes with Grissom and Willows returning to help the CSIs solve a catastrophic case that paralyzes all of Las Vegas.

episodes.title: Why-Fi
episodes.description: Avery welcomes D.B. Russell to the team as they investigate a burglary/homicide committed by someone who hacked the home's security system remotely. Also, Avery considers moving to a new position within the hierarchy of the FBI, Krumitz is a witness in his sister's trial, Elijah deals with a delicate family situation and more is revealed about Nelson's and Raven's backgrounds.

episodes.title: Heart Me
episodes.description: Raven's friend Tracy is hacked by a man she met on a dating app; things get even more complicated when the hacker is found dead and Tracy wakes up with the murder weapon and no memory of what happened.

episodes.title: Brown Eyes, Blue Eyes
episodes.description: A police officer's body camera is hacked and the incendiary video goes viral. The team investigates to learn the truth and find the hacker before the small town where the cop worked erupts in unrest.

episodes.title: Red Crone
episodes.description: The Cyber team investigates a child abduction case based on the "Red Crone," an online myth where an abductor lures children through an app on their phones. Also, Elijah's aggressive behavior at work causes Avery to bench him, and romance is in the air for D.B.

episodes.title: Hack E.R.
episodes.description: When a hacker takes control of all networked medical devices at a hospital in Dallas and threatens to kill one patient every hour if his demands are not met, the Cyber team must find the source and figure out how they accessed an airtight security system

episodes.title: Gone in 6 Seconds
episodes.description: When a man is killed by a driverless car while drag racing with street racer Carmen Lopez, Avery and her team must hunt down the hacker who is cyber-jacking vehicles and using them as remote-controlled cars to cause deadly crashes

episodes.title: Corrupted Memory
episodes.description: When someone breaks into a woman's house and murders her while she is video chatting with her parents, Avery's skills are tested when she interviews the only other witness, Tristan Jenkins, an agoraphobic neighbor who is suffering from PTSD following the incident

episodes.title: Python
episodes.description: When Avery's friend, an Interpol agent, is murdered by the #1 criminal on the FBI Cyber's Most Wanted List, Avery risks her life to capture the killer, the Deep Web's most notorious and dangerous drug dealer.

episodes.title: iWitness
episodes.description: The cyber team investigates the murder of a hacker who was hired to erase an assault victim's comments from a confessional website.

episodes.title: Shades of Grey
episodes.description: An innocent bystander is killed when dozens of ATMs spew money into the street. The team investigates the bank heist and learns it was orchestrated by a real-life Robin Hood.

episodes.title: 404: Flight Not Found
episodes.description: When the Cyber team investigates what appears to be a hack into air traffic control's communication system, a greater threat emerges when a flight vanishes into thin air, drawing the team into the world's first case of cyber-hijacking

episodes.title: Going Viral
episodes.description: When residents of New York City cannot reach the police when calling 911, the Cyber team realizes this is an airborne computer virus that is infecting cell phones and must find the hacker responsible. Also, D.B. meets a woman after responding to a mistaken text sent by her.

episodes.title: The Walking Dead
episodes.description: Avery and the Cyber team attempt to work with black hat hacker Stella Kaine, to track down the hacker who took identity theft to a new level and digitally "killed" Avery's ex-husband.

episodes.title: Fit-and-Run
episodes.description: When a jogger's body is found, the Cyber team use the fitness tracker she was wearing at the time of the murder to retrace her steps for the entire night leading up to her death.

episodes.title: Python's Revenge
episodes.description: Cyber's most notorious criminal, Python, returns to kidnap Avery's surrogate daughter, making the team decipher a series of elaborate code-like puzzles in an attempt to save her life.

episodes.title: 5 Deadly Sins
episodes.description: The Cyber team tracks a vigilante who is killing the biggest offenders of objectionable posts on social media websites.

episodes.title: Flash Squad
episodes.description: The Cyber team investigates when users of a traffic app are rerouted to remote locations and robbed by masked women. Also, Russell reconnects with Greer Latimore after the team completes business in Los Angeles.

episodes.title: Legacy
episodes.description: The fate of the U.S. government is at stake as Avery and the Cyber team search for the hacker responsible for the largest breach of highly classified data in history after millions of federal employee files are stolen. Also, Avery and her ex-husband have a heart-to-heart and D. B. considers a future with Greer,

episodes.title: Legacy
episodes.description: Facing an existential threat that could bring down the entire Crime Lab and release thousands of convicted killers back onto the neon-lit streets of Vegas, a brilliant new team of investigators led by Maxine Roby must enlist the help of old friends Gil Grissom and Sara Sidle. This combined force will deploy the latest forensic techniques to do what they do best - follow the evidence - in order to preserve and serve justice in Sin City. In the premiere episode, an attack on Jim Brass kicks off a twisted conspiracy targeting the Las Vegas crime lab.

episodes.title: Honeymoon in Vegas
episodes.description: Gil Grissom and Sara Sidle come to the aid of a former colleague who is implicated in tampering with evidence. Maxine and the rest of the CSI team work the murder of a couple slain on their wedding day, following the evidence to the salacious underbelly of the Las Vegas elite.

episodes.title: Under the Skin
episodes.description: Grissom and Sara's investigation into charges against David Hodges heats up as Internal Affairs joins the hunt. Also, pressure rises for the CSIs when a video game developer's body is found floating in a fountain before a huge gaming tournament.

episodes.title: Long Pig
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates when a body is dug up in the luau pit of a Hawaiian-themed hotel. Also, Internal Affairs begins to question Grissom and Sara's return to the crime lab.

episodes.title: Let the Chips Fall
episodes.description: As Grissom and Sara close in on who framed Hodges, the CSI team investigates a lock room murder mystery at 30,000 feet, when a cargo plane lands autonomously at McCarran Airport and everyone on board has been killed.

episodes.title: Funhouse
episodes.description: Max puts CSI on lockdown when evidence in a new murder tips Grissom and Sara to a new suspect in the crime lab. Also, Folsom and Allie investigate a series of chilling killings at a dilapidated clown-themed hotel.

episodes.title: In the Blood
episodes.description: An abandoned horse covered in blood leads the CSI team to a halfway house for convicted murderers. Also, Grissom and Sara begin to circle their prime suspect in the David Hodges case.

episodes.title: Pipe Cleaner
episodes.description: When the CSIs are called to investigate human remains found in a convention center owner's bathtub, Sara and Grissom use the case to get close to attorney Anson Wix's star forensic expert witness, just days before David Hodges' trial begins.

episodes.title: Waiting in the Wings
episodes.description: The CSI team looks closely at the eccentric world of sideshows when a couple of performers are discovered burned in a pit. Also, Hodges mulls a plea deal as his criminal trial kicks off, while Max, Grissom and Sara search for evidence to exonerate him.

episodes.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered
episodes.description: When David Hodges goes missing, the entire CSI team searches for any piece of evidence that can help locate him, clear his name and save the reputation of the entire crime lab.

episodes.title: She's Gone
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate the murder of a dominatrix found near her secret sex dungeon.

episodes.title: The Painted Man
episodes.description: As Halloween descends on Sin City, the CSIs investigate when a creepy mannequin prop inside a popular haunted house turns out to be a real dead body. Also, Catherine enlists the help of Folsom to search for her friend who disappeared.

episodes.title: Story of a Gun
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates after a group of teens discover a dead woman behind the wheel of an abandoned car in a Nevada ghost town.

episodes.title: Koala
episodes.description: When three masked assailants invade a home and murder an entire family, including a pregnant woman, the CSIs are called to the scene to investigate. Catherine leads the team through the emotional case, which intensifies her own longing to reconnect with her estranged daughter, Lindsey.

episodes.title: In Harm's Way
episodes.description: After all the guests attending an upscale fundraising soiree for the science department at a local university fall ill, the CSI team gears up to investigate. Also, Catherine enlists Grace's roommate to help her find clues after Grace disappears.

episodes.title: There's the Rub
episodes.description: Max leads her team to investigate the death of a prestigious Michelin-starred chef found hanging in his restaurant's walk-in freezer.

episodes.title: Burned
episodes.description: A mysterious bigfoot-like footprint found near a crime scene puzzles the CSI team as they work to uncover who - or what - killed a father and son

episodes.title: Grace Note
episodes.description: Catherine's frustration intensifies when a lead suspect in Grace's disappearance is found murdered. The team exhausts all their skills to figure out who killed the suspect, and if his death will lead them to Grace.

episodes.title: In the White Room
episodes.description: When the bodies of two Regency Romantic Festival attendees are discovered, the CSI team uncovers a shocking link between their murders and previous cases.

episodes.title: Eyeballs
episodes.description: A social media influencer party ends with the brutal murder of a popular guest. Chris Park's side hustle makes him uniquely qualified to lead the CSI team in their investigation.

episodes.title: Trinket
episodes.description: When a young, non-verbal boy is found hiding in a stranger's garage, the CSI team searches for his missing mother. Also, Max receives a strange letter with symbols in silver ink that Folsom and Allie recognize from prior crime scenes.

episodes.title: When the Dust Settles
episodes.description: Catherine's day off with her granddaughter gets interrupted when a woman wakes up from a four-year coma and remembers details from the night her sister died.

episodes.title: Boned
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates the death of an archaeologist found near the breakthrough discovery of an ancient civilization. Also, Max locates another cryptic note written in familiar silver ink after a mentally distressed woman kills her attacker.

episodes.title: Third Time's the Charm
episodes.description: The CSIs investigate the mysterious death of a competitive eating contestant, and Chavez partners with Allie to prove where the mysterious silver ink notes have been coming from.

episodes.title: Ashes, Ashes
episodes.description: A silver ink note threatening Maxine Roby's life is found at the crime lab, sending the entire CSI team to crack who is behind the notes and how they connect to other murder cases.

episodes.title: We All Fall Down
episodes.description: Medical examiner Sonya's life is in jeopardy when she is exposed to a mysterious poison as the CSI team races to find the antidote and the silver ink murderer who appears to be targeting the Crime Lab. Max's ex-husband, Daniel, returns to make sure that she and their son are safe.

episodes.title: The Promise
episodes.description: When the body of a young girl who was killed over 40 years ago is discovered at the bottom of Lake Mead, Max Roby promises her mother, Raquel Williams, that the CSI team will finally find justice for her daughter.

episodes.title: Fractured
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates a bomb that detonated during a masquerade party for wealthy investors at the site of a new casino.

episodes.title: Dead Memories
episodes.description: When wrongly accused former suspect Gene Farrow enters the Crime Lab covered in blood, wielding a cleaver and looking for Allie Rajan, the CSI team investigates his peculiar story about a macabre party with a fatal ending.

episodes.title: Shell Game
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates a case where an ambitious investigative reporter is found dead at a peanut factory. Also, everyone in the crime lab buzzes over who Max will promote to day shift supervisor.

episodes.title: Dying Words
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates a murder case that hits close to home for Folsom - when he is forced to sit this investigation out, he does his own digging with help from Trey. Worried Folsom will do something he regrets if he gets his hands on the killer, the team members find themselves racing to arrest the suspect first.

episodes.title: The Reaper
episodes.description: With their respected colleague Josh Folsom under arrest for the death of Kahn Schefter – the man responsible for killing Folsom's mother – the CSI team combs through every crumb of forensic evidence to determine his innocence or guilt.

episodes.title: Scar Tissue
episodes.description: With a new piece of evidence at play, Catherine Willows reopens an investigation from her past that never got solved after a violent attack left her hospitalized. Internal affairs begins questioning Folsom.

episodes.title: Rat Packed
episodes.description: The CSI team is called to investigate when the bodies of Frank Sinatra and Joey Bishop impersonators are discovered behind the drywall of a home construction project. Also, Folsom must face the review board about the future of his career.

episodes.title: Health and Wellness
episodes.description: As the CSI team investigates the death of a man visiting Las Vegas for a health and wellness convention, a fiery explosion traps Allie Rajan in the basement of an abandoned hospital.

episodes.title: It Was Automation
episodes.description: When a mechanic is found murdered in a dark factory, the CSI team investigates whether the perpetrator was human or a humanoid robot with an AI operating system.

episodes.title: Atomic City
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates a radioactive crime scene that left a father and son dead.

episodes.title: Coinkydink
episodes.description: When a fitness guru is found dead in a gym sauna and his soon to be son-in-law is found dead from an apparent hunting accident, the CSI team investigates to see if these deaths are unrelated tragic accidents or if they're connected.

episodes.title: The Artist is Present
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates when a plastinated nervous system is found hanging above a local car dealership. Also, Chavez and Max search for a missing source in their ongoing investigation of the robotics factory.

episodes.title: Heavy Metal
episodes.description: The CSI team investigates the death of a local antique shop owner who died from an apparent gunshot wound that is missing one important clue - the bullet. Also, Max makes an important breakthrough in the ongoing case with Ocho from the robotics factory.

episodes.title: Tunnel Vision
episodes.description: After an explosion in a bio lab, the CSI team races to determine which nerve agent left one of their own unconscious, while the others explore a dangerous underground tunnel to find another CSI who got kidnapped during the blast.
